changed_files.change: Add the single final CoreTheoryClosure import to the lowest existing public aggregation root.

reason: CoreTheoryClosure transitively imports all 13 added production modules. The existing UEOT -> Compression -> TheoryCompletion public path exposes them with one additional edge. UEOT.V3 is a separate public aggregate, not the parent of Compression; it is left unchanged as required by the original minimal-import handoff.

build_advice.meaning: The default lean_lib UEOT target traverses its dependency graph and incrementally rebuilds changed/new dependencies. It includes all four public roots. Preserve current toolchain, Lake manifest and cache; do not lake clean.
build_advice.do_not_claim: Do not describe incremental Lake reuse as a fresh full recompilation.

public_export_claim: All 13 new modules become reachable from UEOT, UEOT.V3.Compression and UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion. No new exports are asserted for the separate UEOT.V3 root.

native_attribution.basis: root-reported observation of the existing private G1 result metadata; the integration author did not read or export the private result
native_attribution.status_of_this_patch: New external engineering candidate under existing Core authorization, not native candidate adoption
